test_title: PYST 21: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 3 1 4 6 9 3 5 7 7 9 3 8 6 3 4 4 2 4 7 3 3 8 7 2 2 7 1 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 3 1 4 6 9 3 5 7 7 9 3 8 6 3 4 4 2 4 7 3 3 8 7 2 2 7 1 (Right)

Now,

Even numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Even — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdc50b72a0f5f67ec5dff03db38c13190d7694291ef6b84494db988cb44bc8d0.png] 

Thus, there is one even number, which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
